results.sql: SELECT SUM((fs.gross_amount - fs.discount_amount) / COALESCE(fx.eur_rate, 1)) AS net_sales_eur FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.sales_date = dd.date JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id LEFT JOIN fx_rate fx ON fs.sales_date = fx.rate_date AND fs.currency = fx.currency WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 2025 AND dd.fiscal_month = 3 AND ds.region_name = 'Dél-Alföld' AND fs.is_return = FALSE AND fs.is_cancelled = FALSE
assumptions: Net sales is calculated as gross_amount minus discount_amount
Returns and cancelled transactions are excluded from net sales
Currency conversion uses the EUR rate for the sales date
If no FX rate is found for a currency on a date, a rate of 1 is assumed (though this should be rare)
Fiscal month 3 corresponds to March in the fiscal calendar

results.sql: SELECT SUM((fs.gross_amount - fs.discount_amount - fs.vat_amount) / COALESCE(fx.eur_rate, 1)) AS net_revenue_eur FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.sales_date = dd.date JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id LEFT JOIN fx_rate fx ON fs.sales_date = fx.rate_date AND fs.currency = fx.currency WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 2025 AND dd.fiscal_month = 3 AND ds.region_name = 'Dél-Alföld' AND fs.is_return = FALSE AND fs.is_cancelled = FALSE
assumptions: A nettó árbevétel = bruttó összeg - kedvezmény - ÁFA
Az árfolyam konverzió az fx_rate táblából származik az adott dátumra és devizanévre
A visszáruk (is_return=TRUE) és törölt tételek (is_cancelled=TRUE) kizárásra kerülnek
A Dél-Alföld régió a dim_store.region_name mezőben pontosan így szerepel

results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fs.receipt_id) AS receipt_count FROM fact_sales fs JOIN dim_store ds ON fs.store_id = ds.store_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.sales_date = dd.date WHERE ds.region_name = 'Dél-Alföld' AND dd.fiscal_year = 2025 AND dd.fiscal_month = 3
assumptions: The question refers to fiscal month 3 (March) in fiscal year 2025
Dél-Alföld is a region name in the dim_store table
We count distinct receipt_id values to get the number of receipts
Cancelled and returned transactions are included in the count as they are still receipts
